# Test pe fmt command - prompt formatting standardization

# Format single file
exec pe fmt prompt.txt
stdout 'prompt.txt'

# Check formatted output
cmp prompt.txt prompt_expected.txt

# Format directory
exec pe fmt prompts/
stdout 'prompts/context.txt'
stdout 'prompts/instruction.txt'
stdout 'prompts/example.txt'

# Format with check only (no changes)
exec pe fmt --check well-formatted.txt
# No output means it's already formatted

# Format check with issues
! exec pe fmt --check badly-formatted.txt
stdout 'badly-formatted.txt'
stderr 'File needs formatting'

# List formatting issues
exec pe fmt --list badly-formatted.txt
stdout 'Formatting issues:'
stdout '  Line 3: Trailing whitespace'
stdout '  Line 5: Inconsistent spacing'
stdout '  Line 8: Missing final newline'

# Format with specific style
exec pe fmt --style anthropic prompt.txt
contains prompt.txt 'Human:'
contains prompt.txt 'Assistant:'

# Format stdin
stdin 'Unformatted    prompt   with  issues'
exec pe fmt -
stdout 'Unformatted prompt with issues'

# Format with diff output
exec pe fmt --diff prompt-to-format.txt
stdout '--- a/prompt-to-format.txt'
stdout '+++ b/prompt-to-format.txt'
stdout '-Analyze  this   text'
stdout '+Analyze this text'

# Format all files recursively
exec pe fmt --recursive .
stdout 'Formatted 5 files'

# Format with custom rules
exec pe fmt --rules format-rules.yaml prompt.txt
stdout 'Applied custom formatting rules'

# Preserve specific patterns
exec pe fmt --preserve '{{.*}}' template.txt
contains template.txt '{{.Variable}}'

# Auto-fix common issues
exec pe fmt --fix prompt-with-issues.txt
stdout 'Fixed issues:'
stdout '  ✓ Normalized quotes'
stdout '  ✓ Fixed punctuation spacing'
stdout '  ✓ Standardized line breaks'

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze  this   text    
and provide insights.  


-- prompt_expected.txt --
Analyze this text
and provide insights.

-- well-formatted.txt --
This prompt is already well formatted.
No changes needed here.

-- badly-formatted.txt --
This  has   issues  
Multiple    spaces  
No final newline

-- prompts/context.txt --
You  are  an  AI  assistant.  

-- prompts/instruction.txt --
Help   the   user.  

-- prompts/example.txt --
Example   text.  

-- prompt-to-format.txt --
Analyze  this   text  

-- format-rules.yaml --
rules:
  - name: "sentence-case"
    pattern: "^[a-z]"
    replacement: "capitalize"
  - name: "oxford-comma"
    pattern: "([^,]+), ([^,]+) and"
    replacement: "$1, $2, and"

-- template.txt --
Process  {{.Variable}}  and  return  results.  

-- prompt-with-issues.txt --
Analyze this text . Fix "these" quotes .Add proper spacing.
